name: Eco Explorer
description: Learned how to protect local habitats, reduce waste, and lead a neighborhood clean-up event.

uniformPlacement.position: Upper left, near the shoulder seam

criteria: Complete a nature observation journal for one week.
Organize or participate in a community clean-up day.
Teach fellow scouts about recycling best practices.

name: First Aid Star
description: Demonstrated first aid basics, assembled a troop emergency kit, and practiced emergency communication.
criteria: Learn the steps to handle minor cuts, burns, and sprains.
Assemble a personal first aid kit with labeled supplies.
Role-play emergency calls with the troop leader.

name: Coding Quest
description: Explored algorithms, built a simple website, and introduced coding to younger scouts.
criteria: Create and share a mini-website about a favorite topic.
Host a 20-minute coding activity for Daisy scouts.
